# ellmos-ai / ellmos-voice-io

> Local-first speech input, speech output, and wake-word helpers for LLM systems.

Last-checked: 2026-08-25
Test-suite: 40/40 passed (pytest, Python 3.12)
Version: 0.2.0
Release-state: private repository; not published to PyPI

## Summary

`ellmos-voice-io` is a lightweight, LLM-neutral Python runtime providing
explicit local-first primitives for file Speech-to-Text (STT), Text-to-Speech
(TTS), and caller-owned wake-word detection. The base package has no runtime
dependencies, background service, storage, telemetry, or implicit network use.

## Security and privacy contract

- Optional engines are imported lazily and only after an explicit operation.
- Vosk and Piper require caller-provided local model paths.
- Whisper requires a caller-provided local model file or the explicit
  `allow_model_download=True` network opt-in.
- Wake-word microphone access occurs only inside the synchronous
  `WakeWordListener.listen()` call and is cleaned up on stop or exception.
- `ellmos-voice-io status` is read-only and never opens audio hardware,
  downloads models, or writes state.
- Audio files, transcripts, model licenses, consent, retention, and transport
  remain caller responsibilities.

## Capability matrix

| Primitive | Optional engine | Boundary |
|---|---|---|
| File STT | Vosk | Explicit local model directory |
| File STT | OpenAI Whisper | Explicit local model file or download opt-in |
| TTS playback/file | pyttsx3 | Installed system voices |
| TTS file | Piper | Explicit local ONNX model |
| Wake word | openWakeWord + PyAudio + NumPy | Explicit synchronous microphone call |

## Primary files

- `README.md` — English overview, install, API, privacy, and ecosystem.
- `README_de.md` — German overview with the same technical contract.
- `SECURITY.md` — bilingual vulnerability and privacy boundaries.
- `ROADMAP.md` — verified gates and remaining external decisions.
- `RELEASE_GATE.md` — private/public/PyPI release boundary and evidence.
- `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md` — direct optional dependency and model-license notes.
- `docs/ai-act-note.md` — technical deployment and transparency boundary.
- `SKILL.md` — agent-facing usage and safety rules.
- `ellmos-module.v2.json` — machine-readable capability manifest.
- `src/ellmos_voice_io/` — runtime implementation.
- `tests/` — deterministic tests without hardware, models, or network.

## Release boundary

This file does not authorize repository visibility changes, tags, releases,
registry uploads, credentials, microphone access, or model downloads. Those
actions remain separate, explicit gates.
